title: Casper and the Lantern
author: Lior Sterling
blurb: Hazel Thornbury, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
